NAME: PERSON
POPULATION: persons within the frame/universe of the admitting source
UNIVERSE: source-specific; never assumed to be all Argentine residents unless the source's own frame says so
GRAIN: one row per person per observation period
PRODUCER: source-specific (e.g. INDEC for EPH, STEySS/OEDE for SIPA/MLER)
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: administrative registration or household survey enumeration, depending on source
IS: a person-level count or estimate observed within a defined universe and period
NOTES: Definition reused as-is from V1's frozen PERSON object. LABOR does not broaden or narrow it.

NAME: JOB
POPULATION: declared/registered positions within the admitting source's frame
GRAIN: one row per job per observation period
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: national-accounts labour-input estimation or administrative job registration, depending on source
IS: a declared position or job, not a unique person
NOTES: GOV-006 binding: MLER does not realize JOB on the ingested artifact. Inherited unchanged.

NAME: EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP
POPULATION: registered employment relationships within the admitting source's frame
GRAIN: one row per relationship per observation period
IS: an employer-worker spell or relationship
NOTES: V1 restricted this object, on MLER specifically, to 'relationship_sequence' only (GOV-006). LABOR keeps that restriction; ADAPTED (not REUSED_AS_REFERENCE) only because LABOR's definition text is generalized across sources rather than copied verbatim from one source-role mapping.

NAME: EMPLOYER
POPULATION: registered employers within the admitting source's frame
GRAIN: one row per employer per observation period
IS: an employing or insured party
NOTES: GOV-006 binding: EMPLOYER is UNREALIZED on the MLER artifact specifically. Any future LABOR use of MLER RAW must preserve this exact restriction (see metadata/v1/v1-inheritance-map.json PROHIBITED_USE).

NAME: TAX_REGISTRATION
POPULATION: tax/registration records within the admitting source's frame
GRAIN: one row per registration record per observation period
IS: a registration record, not proof of a unique employed person
NOTES: Central to Regime B's core prohibition: TAX_REGISTRATION != EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP.

NAME: REGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT
POPULATION: persons/relationships/jobs within an administratively registered universe (SIPA/CGI/MLER-mapped)
UNIVERSE: the union of universes covered by admitted registration-based sources; never assumed to equal total employment
GRAIN: aggregate stock per period, decomposable to its underlying PERSON/EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP/JOB rows
PRODUCER: derived by LABOR from admitted registration-based sources, not itself a primary producer
IS: the stock of employment activity that is administratively visible through registration systems
V1_REFERENCES: Composed from V1-mapped SIPA/CGI/MLER objects (PERSON, EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP, JOB) restricted to their administratively registered scope; no single V1 object of this exact name exists
NOTES: Guards the Regime A default stated in LAB-0 Charter section 3: Regime A does not automatically equal 'all Argentine work'.

NAME: UNREGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT
POPULATION: labour activity outside the frame of REGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT's admitted sources
UNIVERSE: not directly observable via SIPA/CGI/MLER/SRT/BESS; requires a household-survey source (EPH) or an explicit proxy
GRAIN: aggregate stock per period, if and when an admitted source can approach it
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: TO_BE_DETERMINED_AT_SOURCE_ADMISSION (household survey self-report is the only inventoried candidate mechanism)
IS: labour activity not captured by the administrative registration systems that produce REGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT
IS_NOT: an informality rate (that is a metric computed FROM this and REGISTERED_EMPLOYMENT, not this object itself)
V1_REFERENCES: No V1 object; V1 never retrieved EPH RAW, the only inventoried source capable of approaching this population
NOTES: Operationalization is gated on EPH admission (see metadata/sources/source-admission-plan.json).

NAME: LABOR_FORCE_STATUS
UNIT: one categorical classification per person per period
POPULATION: persons within a household-survey universe
UNIVERSE: source-specific (e.g. EPH's 31 urban agglomerates plus third-quarter total-urban extension)
GRAIN: one classification per person per reference period
PRODUCER: TO_BE_DETERMINED_AT_SOURCE_ADMISSION (INDEC/EPH is the only inventoried candidate)
IS: a categorical labour-force classification of a PERSON within a reference period, as classified by a household survey methodology
V1_REFERENCES: V1's SRC-INDEC-EPH manifest entry maps only PERSON/HOUSEHOLD/HOUR; no LABOR_FORCE_STATUS-equivalent object exists in V1's vocabulary
NOTES: Operationalization is gated on EPH admission.

NAME: LABOR_INCOME
UNIT: monetary flow per person per period
POPULATION: persons receiving income from labour activity in any modality
GRAIN: one amount per person per income component per period
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: TO_BE_DETERMINED_AT_SOURCE_ADMISSION (household survey self-report or administrative payroll record, depending on source)
IS: income received by a person from labour activity, in any modality, within a reference period
V1_REFERENCES: No V1 object; distinguished from WAGE_BILL (V1-reused, aggregate, LAB-OBJ-0011) per the LAB-A3 rule SALARY != LABOR_INCOME
NOTES: Any future use must keep NOMINAL vs REAL and STOCK vs FLOW distinct (LAB-A3 rules).

NAME: SALARY
UNIT: monetary rate per relationship or job
POPULATION: employment relationships or jobs with an observable pay rate
GRAIN: one rate per relationship/job per period
IS: a wage or pay rate associated with a specific EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP or JOB, nominal or real
V1_REFERENCES: No V1 object; SALARY != LABOR_INCOME is an explicit LAB-A3 rule this object exists to enforce
NOTES: Must not be aggregated into WAGE_BILL without an explicit, governed reconciliation rule.

NAME: WAGE_BILL
POPULATION: national-accounts labour remuneration aggregate
GRAIN: one aggregate value per period
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: national-accounts estimation from surveys and administrative records
IS: aggregate labour remuneration flow within a universe/period
NOTES: Reused unchanged from V1.

NAME: HOUR
POPULATION: hours worked or usual hours within the admitting source's frame
GRAIN: one measured quantity per person/job per period
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: survey self-report or national-accounts estimation, depending on source
IS: a measured hours-worked quantity, not a person or household record unit
NOTES: Reused unchanged; deliberately not split into a separate WORKED_HOURS object to avoid inflating the vocabulary (see reports/lab_0_5/LAB-0.5-decision-log.md).

NAME: CONTRIBUTOR
POPULATION: persons or entities contributing to the social-security system
GRAIN: one row per contributor per period
IS: a contributing person or contributor record
V1_REFERENCES: V1 statistical object CONTRIBUTOR (SIPA, ARCA, ANSES, BESS)
NOTES: Reused unchanged.

NAME: BENEFIT_INSTANCE
UNIT: one entitlement, extant in a period
POPULATION: eligible beneficiaries within the admitting source's frame
GRAIN: one entitlement instance per period (stock, not flow)
IS: an entitlement extant in a period (a stock)
V1_REFERENCES: V1 statistical object BENEFIT_INSTANCE (BESS eligible Beneficios)
NOTES: Amendment F binding: GOV-003 and GOV-009 must be read jointly whenever BESS is used with this object -- BESS is not independent corroboration of ANSES/ARCA-derived series.

NAME: LEGAL_FORM
POPULATION: persons or arrangements with a formal legal/tax categorization
GRAIN: one classification per person/arrangement per period
IS: the formal legal/tax categorization under which labour or services are provided (e.g. employee, monotributista, autonomo)
NOTES: No V1 analogue; Regime B objects are new to LABOR. Core of the Regime B prohibition LEGAL_FORM != ECONOMIC_RELATIONSHIP.

NAME: MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION
POPULATION: persons registered under the Argentine simplified tax regime (Monotributo)
GRAIN: one registration record per person per period
IS: a specific Argentine simplified tax-registration category record
IS_NOT: CONTRACTOR (undefined object; this term is never used as a LABOR object name)
TAX_REGISTRATION (broader class; this is one instance of it)
NOTES: Directly enforces the frozen prohibition MONOTRIBUTO != CONTRACTOR by never defining CONTRACTOR as a LABOR object at all.

NAME: SELF_EMPLOYMENT
POPULATION: persons supplying labour/services without being party to a documented EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP
GRAIN: one arrangement per person per period, where observable
PRODUCER: EPH (self-reported occupational category, CAT_OCUP) for the labour-force classification; a legal/administrative producer (e.g. ARCA) would still be needed for any registration-based cross-check
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: TO_BE_DETERMINED_AT_SOURCE_ADMISSION (proxy via tax/registration records; direct observation of the underlying economic arrangement is not expected to be available)
IS: a labour arrangement in which a person supplies labour or services without being party to a legally defined EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP
IS_NOT: MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION (a legal instrument, not the underlying economic arrangement)
NOTES: The real economic arrangement is expected to be, at best, partially observable through proxies. Any claim using this object inherits Regime B's default NOT_IDENTIFIABLE presumption until displaced by evidence. Updated at LAB-B (2026-09-18): EPH's CAT_OCUP directly observes the self-reported labour-force category 'cuenta propia' (self-account work), which is a genuine, direct observable for the labour-arrangement type this object defines -- not a proxy or an inferred equivalence. This does NOT identify whether a given self-employed person is genuinely independent or economically dependent on a single counterpart (see LAB-OBJ-0018); that finer distinction remains unidentified. See reports/lab_b/LAB-B-source-capability.md.

NAME: ECONOMIC_DEPENDENCE
POPULATION: workers with an observable concentration of income/activity on a single or dominant counterpart
UNIVERSE: unknown; no admitted source is expected to observe this directly
GRAIN: one condition assessment per person per period, if ever observable
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: no known direct observation mechanism among inventoried sources; would require a proxy (e.g. concentration of invoiced counterparts) not currently admitted
IS: a proxy-observable condition indicating a worker's economic reliance on a single or dominant counterpart, distinct from legal employment status
NOTES: Registered explicitly as a design case likely to resolve to NOT_IDENTIFIABLE (LAB-0.5 instruction section 14). Not to be 'rescued' with a weak proxy absent a LAB-GOV ruling.

NAME: JOB_POSTING
POPULATION: advertisements published on a given platform
GRAIN: one posting per platform per publication instance
PRODUCER: the platform on which the posting appears
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: public listing capture (not built in LAB-0.5)
IS: a public advertisement of an alleged intent to hire, on a specific platform, at a specific time
IS_NOT: VACANCY (the underlying real, possibly-unfilled need; a posting can exist without one, e.g. evergreen or decoy postings)
NOTES: No corpus exists yet (GENERATED_SOURCE, not built in LAB-0.5 or P0).

NAME: VACANCY
POPULATION: employers' real, current intent to fill a position
GRAIN: one need per employer per position per period, where observable
PRODUCER: the employer (not directly observable by LABOR)
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: none known; only proxied, imperfectly, by JOB_POSTING
IS: an employer's real, current need or intent to fill a position, independent of whether it is ever advertised
NOTES: Kept distinct from JOB_POSTING specifically so that 'describing postings' is never silently equated with 'describing real vacancies' (LAB-0.5 instruction section 8).

NAME: APPLICATION
POPULATION: individuals who submit a response to a JOB_POSTING
GRAIN: one submission per person per posting
PRODUCER: the platform/ATS on which the application is submitted
IS: an individual's submitted response to a JOB_POSTING
IS_NOT: PERSON (a person may submit zero, one, or many applications)
NOTES: Core of the Regime C prohibition APPLICATION != HIRE.

NAME: HIRE
POPULATION: persons who enter an EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP as a documented consequence of a recruitment process
GRAIN: one event per person per recruitment process
IS: the transition event of a person entering an EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP as a documented outcome of a recruitment process
IS_NOT: EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP (HIRE is the transition event, not the resulting stock)
NOTES: Distinguishing 'describing postings' from 'describing real hires' is explicitly required (LAB-0.5 instruction section 8).

NAME: SELECTION_STAGE
POPULATION: steps within a recruitment process associated with one APPLICATION
GRAIN: one stage per application per step (e.g. screening, interview, assessment)
IS: a discrete step within a recruitment process associated with one APPLICATION
NOTES: Needed to eventually ask how many stages a process has, without conflating stage count with outcome.

NAME: AI_HIRING_EVENT
POPULATION: instances where an AI system acts on a SELECTION_STAGE or APPLICATION
GRAIN: one event per AI action per selection stage/application
PRODUCER: the platform/ATS/employer whose AI system acts
IS: an instance of an AI system, classified ASSISTIVE/FILTERING/EVALUATIVE/DECISIONAL, acting on a SELECTION_STAGE or APPLICATION
IS_NOT: a human-only decision without AI involvement
NOTES: There is no obligation to obtain national prevalence for this object (LAB-0 Charter section 18, LAB-C2). May remain NOT_IDENTIFIABLE at the population level indefinitely.

NAME: PRICE_INDEX
POPULATION: consumption basket of goods and services representative of resident-household spending
UNIVERSE: INDEC IPC Nacional coverage: national total and six statistical regions (GBA, Pampeana, Noreste, Noroeste, Cuyo, Patagonia)
GRAIN: one index value per COICOP division/group/nivel-general row per region per month
PRODUCER: INDEC (Direccion de Indices de Precios de Consumo)
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: retail/point-of-sale price collection instrument, aggregated by expenditure weights into a Laspeyres-type index
IS: a price-level index for a defined consumption basket, at a stated base period, used as a deflator input; it is not itself a labour-market object
IS_NOT: REAL_WAGE or any other deflated/real-terms quantity (that is a metric COMPUTED FROM this object and a nominal quantity, not this object itself)
an inflation rate (a period-over-period transformation of this object, not the object itself)
a labour-market participation or employment measure
V1_REFERENCES: SRC-INDEC-IPC-NACIONAL (V1 manifest-only reference; V1 never retrieved IPC RAW)
NOTES: Created at LAB-A2 specifically so lineage.schema.json's STATISTICAL_OBJECT field has a real object to point to for the IPC Evidence Root (LAB-ROOT-0006). Admission of this object does not authorize REAL_WAGE/REAL_LABOR_INCOME computation; that remains a LAB-A3-or-later decision.

NAME: AUTONOMOS_REGISTRATION
POPULATION: self-employed/independent workers registered under Argentina's general Autonomos tax/contribution regime (distinct from the simplified Monotributo regime)
GRAIN: aggregate monthly stock, not person-level microdata
PRODUCER: ARCA (Agencia de Recaudacion y Control Aduanero), Boletin Anual de Seguridad Social
OBSERVATION_MECHANISM: administrative tax/contribution registration and monthly payment records (SUSS unified collection system)
IS: a registration/contribution record for a person registered under the general Autonomos regime, a specific tax-registration category distinct from Monotributo
IS_NOT: MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION (a different, simplified tax-registration regime with different eligibility criteria)
SELF_EMPLOYMENT (the broader labour-arrangement concept; this is one specific legal/tax instrument some self-employed persons use)
proof of employer intent, subordination, or exclusivity
NOTES: Created at LAB-B1 (2026-09-18) because the admitted ARCA Boletin Anual de Seguridad Social reports 'Cotizantes autonomos' as a category distinct from Monotributo, and lumping them into LAB-OBJ-0016 (MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION specifically) would conflate two legally and administratively distinct tax regimes.
